description: I am honored to receive the endorsement of Meroa "Peep" Benjamin, a respected member of the Bradford Selectboard and a dedicated public servant who has spent years working to strengthen our community.Peep's endorsement reflects a shared belief that the best solutions come when local leaders, residents, and state representatives work together. Our communities deserve a representative who listens, communicates openly, and advocates for practical solutions that improve everyday life for Vermonters.
title: Community Leaders Stand with Nicholas DiLorenzo
